# ⚠️ Risk Assessment Template

## Assessment metadata

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Risk ID | RISK- |
| Feature/project area | |
| Owner | |
| Date | |
| Review date | |
| Status | Open / Mitigating / Accepted / Closed |

## Risk statement

Use the format: Because of **cause**, there is a possibility of **event**, which may result in **impact**.

## Evaluation

| Dimension | Rating | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| Likelihood | Low / Medium / High | |
| Impact | Low / Medium / High / Critical | |
| Overall rating | | |
| Detectability | | |
| Time sensitivity | | |

## Existing controls and evidence

List controls that are actually implemented. Link code, tests, CI results, policies, and operational records. Do not count future plans as current mitigation.

## Treatment plan

| Action | Owner | Due date | Expected risk reduction | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| | | | | |

## Residual risk and acceptance

Explain what remains, who is authorized to accept it, compensating controls, review date, and expiry date if accepted.

## Decision

- [ ] Mitigate
- [ ] Avoid
- [ ] Transfer
- [ ] Accept temporarily
